onboarding.demo_note_next: This is a discovery tour — not a real exercise. Read and click 'Next'. You can skip it and come back later.
onboarding.demo_note_click: This is a discovery tour — not a real exercise. Click the highlighted element or use the buttons. You can skip it and come back later.

dashboard_new_prompt.title: Create your first prompt
dashboard_new_prompt.body: Click 'New prompt' to start building a structured teaching prompt.

new_request_text.title: Describe what you need
new_request_text.body: Write your teaching request in plain language. The assistant will turn it into a structured prompt.

new_submit_request.title: Analyze your request
new_submit_request.body: Click to analyze. If something important is missing, you'll get a quick question instead of a bad prompt.

questions_pick.title: Answer the quick questions
questions_pick.body: Choose an option (or type your own if 'Other' appears). This helps tailor the prompt to your class.

done_save.title: Save it to your library
done_save.body: Click 'Save prompt' to keep it and reuse it later.

languages.title: Languages you teach
languages.body: Add the languages you teach most often. This becomes a default for faster prompt creation.

levels.title: Typical levels
levels.body: Select the levels you teach most. The assistant will use these as defaults when your request is ambiguous.

audience.title: Typical audience
audience.body: Choose your most common audience. This helps tailor activities and examples.

duration.title: Typical session duration
duration.body: Pick a default duration so the generated activities match your real class time.

context.title: Teaching context
context.body: Optional: add where/how you teach (school, private lessons, online, etc.). It helps the AI set better constraints.

save.title: Save your profile
save.body: Click to save. From now on, you'll get fewer questions and better defaults.

upgrade.title: Available for training participants
upgrade.feature_templates: The template library is part of the TeachInspire training. Browse ready-to-use prompts created and validated by trainers.
upgrade.feature_profile: The teacher profile remembers your context (languages, levels, audience) to personalize every prompt automatically. It's part of the TeachInspire training.
upgrade.feature_refine: Guided refinement improves your prompts based on the results you get. It's part of the TeachInspire training.
upgrade.feature_edit: Edit Mode (block editor) is part of the TeachInspire training. You can view your prompts in User and Study modes.
upgrade.feature_submit: Sharing templates with the community is reserved for training participants.
upgrade.library_limit: Your free library is full: {{used}}/{{limit}} prompts saved. Participants save without limits.
